scope: Catalog failures now emit one existing typed request-correlated polite announcement and leave focus intact. A distinct typed Refresh action shares the catalog authority but preserves current focus through both request and receipt; Apps opening retains search focus. Native keyboard and actual AT-SPI retry preserve the files query and recover current matching results after a genuine metadata-bound null catalog. Exact duplicated failed receipts are silent after their first announcement; explicit new failure reads get fresh identities. Unavailable-field Enter, recovery and Escape issue zero launch/window effects. Real AT/Orca status/focus, current control pixels and normal cleanup pass. Current delayed-catalog physical Enter regression passes; existing executable model, 34 typed adapter assertions and announcement/IME browser checks pass.

Current failure is a genuine catalog name-bound failure during an existing query, with exact duplicate receipts and focused physical Enter/AT-SPI retry. Other provider failures, initial-failure entry, output/language/AT breadth, audible speech/braille and spontaneous service loss remain separate.

Original native IME candidate popup remains failed at its retained unchanged deadline; hardware/resource/journey budgets, reproducible package and reversible deployment/rollback remain release obligations.
